description:
Convert PDF, DOCX, EPUB and clipboard text into spoken audio with offline neural voices

AI Voice Studio turns documents into spoken audio books and DAISY talking books on your own computer. It reads PDF, DOC/DOCX, EPUB, HTML, Markdown and plain text (or text on the clipboard), splits the text into pages or chapters, and records each part as a separate WAV, MP3 or FLAC file with an offline neural text-to-speech engine. Every window works with a screen reader: real MSAA names on every control, access keys on every action, keyboard-only operation, and an audit tool that fails the build when a gesture stops working. Synthesis runs locally, so no document leaves the machine.
Adds Help > Check for updates with an automatic daily check, the winget package manifests, and ARP links for Apps and features.
